items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: She was my singer... I had a contract with her

ctx.x: How -- tell me about Lena Horne working with the band.
Well, Lena came to us under a distressed circumstances on our part, and strangely enough through the Apollo. We were playing a two day theater up in the Bronx

called the Casino Theater, and I had a -- I had Ford Leary and Bob Carroll and I had a girl singer, too. I can't remember what her name was. Anyway, they all came down with laryngitis. Not one of them could make a sound. And this was one of these theaters where the band was the whole show. We had to play, put on, you know, an hour, hour and ten minute show, and if you've got no vocalists there again we get back to what I was talking about earlier, the static idea of watching a band play without something else…
